public_gates: select targeted rows from the M503 boundary-pressure matched-current surface
jointly require wrong-history action sensitivity and low terminal clearance slack
require source diversity before any outcome gate
do not run outcome gates, train, or promote checkpoint
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add privileged actor inputs
do not use hidden-hold variants as deployable proof
do not repeat M496 target-z triage unchanged
do not repeat M500 action-only selection unchanged
do not admit high-margin rows to outcome gates
do not tune from private holdouts
hypothesis: The M503 boundary-pressure surface contains source-diverse pairs where one-shot wrong-history changes the short-horizon action trajectory and the normal branch is close enough to the terminal boundary for those differences to matter.
success_criteria: targeted pair selection runs on the M503 combined surface
failure_criteria: selected rows are action-sensitive but high-margin like M500
selected rows are near-boundary but not action-sensitive
training or checkpoint promotion is performed

commands.name: boundary_action_sensitive_selector
commands.command: Run or extend natural_wrong_history_action_sensitive_selector on runs/m503_natural_boundary_pressure_matched_current_summary/combined_matched_pairs.csv with boundary-aware admission thresholds.

commands.name: source_diversity_summary
commands.command: Summarize targeted rows by seed label target config offset and normal-margin buckets before admitting any outcome gate.

decision_rule: M504 may admit a boundary-pressure outcome gate only if targeted rows are both action-sensitive and terminal-boundary-sensitive with source diversity; otherwise redesign the selector or task before outcome testing.
